title: Flow Selection Emphasized Text and Internal Borders
description: Fix flow graph selection styling: node text and internal borders should use emphasized color when selected (like navbar toggles), not primary/active color.
summary: Selected flow node text and internal dividers now use emphasized color (matching navbar toggle active text) instead of primary. flowOverlayLabelFill maps selected/preselect preview labels to border-emphasized-color. dag_node_internal_chrome_stroke treats selection like hover so row/column dividers stay emphasized while the outer node stroke remains primary.
